name: alias_page
doc: One 4 KiB page of the alias region (MapPhysicalMemory / UnmapPhysicalMemory): the single per-page state that replaces nxnative's four bitmaps (mapped, ever exposed, given back, aged). Fresh has never been mapped and reads zero. Stale was mapped and unmapped: its old bytes are still in linear memory, so the next Map zero-fills it first. Mapping a mapped page and unmapping an unmapped one are legal (the SDK does both) and change nothing.
